KING ARIN

ADVISOR 1

Futurism, Your Majesty?

KING ARIN
(nodding)
Yes. We must shed our outdated armor and don the garb of the future. The future of... (he consults a parchment)...vaporwave.

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

KING ARIN
(to his advisors)
We must create a new sense of wonder, a new sense of awe. We must make our kingdom a place where the boundaries between reality and fantasy blur.

ADVISOR 2
(nervously)
But, Your Majesty, what about the traditional values of our kingdom?

KING ARIN
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft, those are so... last season. We must move forward, into the unknown.
